bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 159 (Friday, October 9, 2026)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. EZELL:
H.R. 10776.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 3: the Commerce Clause, grants
Congress the power to regulate commerce with foreign nations,
among the states, and with Indian tribes, forming a
foundation for federal economic authority.
[Page H6036]
